**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- **§ 7.6** is an MFN *in our favour* — Vendor warrants Fees to us will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. Per the playbook, this is welcome and not redlined.
- **§ 12.3** affirmatively confirms we have given no most-favoured-customer (or exclusivity/minimum-volume) commitment, satisfying the preferred element outright.
- No right-to-match, offer-disclosure, or best-terms-to-Vendor mechanic appears in Fees (§ 7), Order Forms (§ 4), or General (§ 30).

No redline proposed.
